overview: A bottle of glue. Right-click any block with it and that block is yours: nobody else breaks it, and no explosion takes it.
Sneak and use it again on something you glued and the glue comes off.

1.0.0: The bottle arrives. Any block at all, one bottle to one block.
Blasts are refused as flatly as pickaxes are.
The player who glued it and operators can take the glue off; nobody else.
No recipe, and there is not going to be one: a creative tab and /give.
It stacks to 64, further with Stackz installed.
A glued block says whose glue it is on the block tip.
